comment: Per-image licence policy for COCO 2017 images. Matched on the licence URL in the 'licenses' table of instances_*2017.json (never on the numeric id). 'allow' = used by default; 'review' = only with --allow-review after an owner decision; 'exclude' = never. An URL not listed here is excluded and reported. Rationale: docs/vision/DATASET_PROVENANCE.md section 3.
